sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Bhupendra Kumar Yadav,G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant; counsel for the informant; learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.107 of 2015, under Sections 363 366, 367, 376 I.P.C. and Section 4 POCSO Act, P.S. Mau, District Chitrakoot, during pendency of the trial.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant is not named in the F.I.R.; the Investigating Officer has not submitted charge sheet against the applicant.
The applicant has been summoned on application moved by the prosecution under Section 319 Cr.P.C.

It has been next submitted that named Pramod Yadav vs State Of Up 3 Others on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138674956/

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 3451 of 2016
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal antecedent.
Moreover, there is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 08.12.2023 and in case, he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. and counsel for the informant opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

5. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Pramod Yadav, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 14.3.2024 Meenu Singh  Pramod Yadav vs State Of Up 3 Others on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138674956/
